variables.name: STUDYID
variables.label: Study Identifier
variables.description: Unique identifier for a study.

variables.name: DOMAIN
variables.label: Domain Abbreviation
variables.description: Two-character abbreviation for the domain.

variables.name: USUBJID
variables.label: Unique Subject Identifier
variables.description: Identifier used to uniquely identify a subject across all studies for all applications or submissions involving the product.

variables.name: FOCID
variables.label: Focus of Study-Specific Interest
variables.description: Identification of a focus of study-specific interest on or within a subject or specimen as called out in the protocol for which a measurement, test, or examination was performed. The value in this variable should have inherent semantic meaning.

variables.name: MBSEQ
variables.label: Sequence Number
variables.description: Sequence number to ensure uniqueness of records within a dataset for a subject. May be any valid number.

variables.name: MBGRPID
variables.label: Group ID
variables.description: Optional group identifier, used to link together a block of related records within a subject in a domain.

variables.name: MBREFID
variables.label: Reference ID
variables.description: Internal or external specimen identifier (e.g., sample ID for a subject sample from which a microbial culture was generated).

variables.name: MBSPID
variables.label: Sponsor-Defined Identifier
variables.description: Sponsor-defined reference number. May be preprinted on the CRF as an explicit line identifier or defined in the sponsor's operational database.

variables.name: MBLNKID
variables.label: Link ID
variables.description: Identifier used to link related records across domains. This may be a one-to-one or a one-to-many relationship. For example, it may be used to link genetic findings (in the PF domain) about a microbe to the original culture of that microbe (in MB), or to susceptibility records (in MS) if needed.

variables.name: MBLNKGRP
variables.label: Link Group ID
variables.description: Identifier used to link related records across domains. This will usually be a many-to-one relationship.

variables.name: MBTESTCD
variables.label: Microbiology Test or Finding Short Name
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C120527
variables.description: Short name of the measurement, test, or finding described in MBTEST. It can be used as a column name when converting a dataset from a vertical to a horizontal format. The value in MBTESTCD cannot be longer than 8 characters, nor can it start with a number (e.g., "1TEST" is not valid). MBTESTCD cannot contain characters other than letters, numbers, or underscores. Examples: "MCORGIDN" for Microbial Organism Identification "GMNCOC" for Gram Negative Cocci.

variables.name: MBTEST
variables.label: Microbiology Test or Finding Name
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C120528
variables.description: Verbatim name of the test or examination used to obtain the measurement or finding. The value in MBTEST cannot be longer than 40 characters. Examples: "Microbial Organism Identification", "Gram Negative Cocci", "HIV-1 RNA".

variables.name: MBTSTDTL
variables.label: Measurement, Test or Examination Detail
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C174225
variables.description: Further description of MBTESTCD and MBTEST. Example: "VIRAL LOAD" when MBTESTCD represents viral genetic material, such as "HCRNA", "QUANTIFICATION" when MBTESTCD represents any organism being quantified.

variables.name: MBCAT
variables.label: Category
variables.description: Used to define a category of related records.

variables.name: MBSCAT
variables.label: Subcategory
variables.description: Used to define a further categorization of MBCAT values.

variables.name: MBORRES
variables.label: Result or Finding in Original Units
variables.description: Result of the microbiology measurement or finding as originally received or collected. Examples for "GRAM STAIN" findings: "+3 MODERATE", "+2 FEW", "<10". Examples for "CULTURE PLATE" findings: "KLEBSIELLA PNEUMONIAE", "STREPTOCOCCUS PNEUMONIAE".

variables.name: MBORRESU
variables.label: Original Units
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C71620
variables.description: Original unit for MBORRES. Example: "mcg/mL".

variables.name: MBSTRESC
variables.label: Result or Finding in Standard Format
variables.description: Contains the result value for all findings copied or derived from MBORRES, in a standard format or standard units. MBSTRESC should store all results or findings in character format; if results are numeric, they should also be stored in numeric format in MBSTRESN. For example, if a test has results "+3 MODERATE", "MOD", and "MODERATE" in MBORRES and these results effectively have the same meaning, they could be represented in standard format in MBSTRESC as "MODERATE".

variables.name: MBSTRESN
variables.label: Numeric Result/Finding in Standard Units
variables.description: Used for continuous or numeric results or findings in standard format; copied in numeric format from MBSTRESC. MBSTRESN should store all numeric test results or findings.

variables.name: MBSTRESU
variables.label: Standard Units
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C71620
variables.description: Standardized units used for MBSTRESC and MBSTRESN.

variables.name: MBRESCAT
variables.label: Result Category
variables.description: Used to categorize the result of a finding in a standard format.

variables.name: MBSTAT
variables.label: Completion Status
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C66789
variables.description: Used to indicate that a question was not asked or a test was not done, or that a test was attempted but did not generate a result. Should be null or have a value of "NOT DONE".

variables.name: MBREASND
variables.label: Reason Not Done
variables.description: Reason not done. Used in conjunction with MBSTAT when value is NOT DONE. Examples: "BROKEN EQUIPMENT", "SUBJECT REFUSED".

variables.name: MBNAM
variables.label: Laboratory/Vendor Name
variables.description: Name or identifier of the vendor (e.g., laboratory) that provided the test results.

variables.name: MBLOINC
variables.label: LOINC Code
variables.description: Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes (LOINC) code for the topic variable (e.g., lab test).

variables.name: MBSPEC
variables.label: Specimen Material Type
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C78734
variables.description: Defines the type of specimen used for a measurement. Examples: "SPUTUM", "BLOOD", "PUS".

variables.name: MBSPCCND
variables.label: Specimen Condition
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C78733
variables.description: Free or standardized text describing the condition of the specimen. Example: "CONTAMINATED".

variables.name: MBLOC
variables.label: Specimen Collection Location
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C74456
variables.description: Anatomical location relevant to the collection of the measurement.

variables.name: MBLAT
variables.label: Laterality
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C99073
variables.description: Qualifier for specimen collection location further detailing laterality. Examples: "RIGHT", "LEFT", "BILATERAL".

variables.name: MBDIR
variables.label: Directionality
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C99074
variables.description: Qualifier for specimen collection location further detailing directionality. Examples: "ANTERIOR", "LOWER", "PROXIMAL".

variables.name: MBMETHOD
variables.label: Method of Test or Examination
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C85492
variables.description: Method of the test or examination. Examples: "GRAM STAIN", "MICROBIAL CULTURE, LIQUID", "QUANTITATIVE REVERSE TRANSCRIPTASE POLYMERASE CHAIN REACTION".

variables.name: MBLOBXFL
variables.label: Last Observation Before Exposure Flag
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C66742
variables.description: Operationally derived indicator used to identify the last non-missing value prior to RFXSTDTC. The value should be "Y" or null.

variables.name: MBBLFL
variables.label: Baseline Flag
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C66742
variables.description: Indicator used to identify a baseline value. Should be "Y" or null. Note that MBBLFL is retained for backward compatibility. The authoritative baseline for statistical analysis is in an ADaM dataset.

variables.name: MBFAST
variables.label: Fasting Status
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C66742
variables.description: Indicator used to identify fasting status. Valid values include "Y", "N", "U", or null if not relevant.

variables.name: MBDRVFL
variables.label: Derived Flag
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C66742
variables.description: Used to indicate a derived record (e.g., a record that represents the average of other records such as a computed baseline). Should be "Y" or null.

variables.name: VISITNUM
variables.label: Visit Number
variables.description: Clinical encounter number. Numeric version of VISIT, used for sorting.

variables.name: VISIT
variables.label: Visit Name
variables.description: Protocol-defined description of a clinical encounter.

variables.name: VISITDY
variables.label: Planned Study Day of Visit
variables.description: Planned study day of VISIT. Should be an integer.

variables.name: TAETORD
variables.label: Planned Order of Element within Arm
variables.description: Number that gives the planned order of the element within the arm for the element which the specimen collection occurred.

variables.name: EPOCH
variables.label: Epoch
variables.codelist: Version-agnostic anchor resource for codelist C99079
variables.description: Epoch associated with the date/time at which the specimen was collected.

variables.name: MBDTC
variables.label: Date/Time of Collection
variables.description: Date/time of specimen collection.

variables.name: MBDY
variables.label: Study Day of Visit/Collection/Exam
variables.description: Study day of the specimen collection, measured as integer days. Algorithm for calculations must be relative to the sponsor-defined RFSTDTC variable in Demographics. This formula should be consistent across the submission.

variables.name: MBTPT
variables.label: Planned Time Point Name
variables.description: Text description of time when specimen should be taken. This may be represented as an elapsed time relative to a fixed reference point, such as time of last dose. See MBTPTNUM and MBTPTREF. Examples: "Start", "5 min post".

variables.name: MBTPTNUM
variables.label: Planned Time Point Number
variables.description: Numeric version of MBTPT used in sorting.

variables.name: MBELTM
variables.label: Planned Elapsed Time from Time Point Ref
variables.description: Planned elapsed time (in ISO 8601) relative to a planned fixed reference (MBTPTREF). This variable is useful where there are repetitive measures. Not a clock time or a date time variable. Represented as an ISO 8601 duration. Examples: "-PT15M" to represent the period of 15 minutes prior to the reference point indicated by MBTPTREF, or "PT8H" to represent the period of 8 hours after the reference point indicated by MBTPTREF.

variables.name: MBTPTREF
variables.label: Time Point Reference
variables.description: Name of the fixed reference point referred to by MBELTM, MBTPTNUM, and MBTPT. Example: "PREVIOUS DOSE".

variables.name: MBRFTDTC
variables.label: Date/Time of Reference Time Point
variables.description: Date/time for a fixed reference time point, MBTPTREF.
